about: compiler/testinputs mutants covering env filtering order, genprogram seed parity, testlog dash-dash cutoff, recorder symlink statting, mount verdict, access peer safety, and seccomp target mode

mutants.name: selfhost-testinputs-testenv-allow-all
mutants.rule: Environment must retain only variables listed in Names.

mutants.name: selfhost-testinputs-testlog-after-separator
mutants.rule: TestLogFlag must stop scanning args at the "--" separator.

mutants.name: selfhost-testinputs-recorder-drop-tool-digest
mutants.rule: RecorderLines must emit ERGO_TOOL_VERSIONS whenever any child executable ran.

mutants.name: selfhost-testinputs-identity-mount-changed-back
mutants.rule: MountVerdict must fail closed when a mount table poll changed even if the before and after tables match.

mutants.name: selfhost-testinputs-access-allow-abstract-unix
mutants.rule: AccessPeer must refuse any connection or binding to an abstract Unix socket.

mutants.name: selfhost-testinputs-access-ignore-changed-read
mutants.rule: AccessValidate must reject a run when an unwritten read input changes before exit.

mutants.name: selfhost-testinputs-seccomp-drop-writefd-in-target
mutants.rule: BuildFilter must include descriptor-write syscalls when target observation mode is enabled.
